course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice softened suggestions with skulle kunna.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Suggesting a lunch, fika, or weekend activity without sounding too direct.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Making and responding to polite suggestions.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik try to choose a low-pressure plan and use softer language to suggest options.

main_focus.name: soft suggestions with skulle kunna
main_focus.description: Use skulle kunna to suggest a possible action politely.
model_examples: Vi skulle kunna ta en fika efter lunch.
Du skulle kunna fråga henne imorgon.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use skulle kunna naturally 2-3 times as a suggestion structure.

avoid_grammar: too many modal verbs in one sentence

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use polite planning chunks that a learner can reuse with colleagues.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions needing a plan or idea.
dialogue_shape.middle: They suggest two possible actions with skulle kunna and respond politely.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose one option or leave it as a flexible plan.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat skulle kunna with different practical verbs

focus: the reason a suggestion is needed
which option is preferred and why
whether the final plan is firm or flexible

sentence_focus: one sentence with skulle kunna for a fika suggestion
one sentence politely accepting a suggestion
one sentence saying something is only a suggestion
one sentence using kanske for softer planning
one sentence comparing a soft suggestion with a firm plan
